Class JSONHandler

java.lang.Object
storage.JSONHandler
public class JSONHandler extends Object
A utility class for loading and saving tasks, categories, priorities, and reminders in JSON format. Leverages the Jackson library to serialize/deserialize data structures.

  • Constructor Summary

    Constructors
    Constructor
    Description
    JSONHandler()
    Constructs a new JSONHandler by creating an ObjectMapper instance, registering the JavaTimeModule for date/time handling, and disabling timestamps for dates.
